sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Typing into a filter no longer re-counts the whole table for the ⏳ pending-edits and LENGTH ⚠️/❌ summary buttons on every keystroke. Those counts are taken once per set of rows and reused until the rows themselves change — a new fetch, a sort, a Load from Disk — so they cost nothing while you type. On Bruce Springsteen's 4174-row Events page that was 8 348 lookups per keystroke, whether the filter left 4000 rows or 26. The buttons show exactly the same numbers as before, including while a filter hides the rows they count.
